summary: Tested VeloSummit climb-side + Open-Elevation profile features end-to-end. Backend pytest: 7/7 passed (famous cols sides, POST with start_lat/lng fetches profile, POST without returns none, PUT notes-only preserves profile, refresh-profile endpoint, 400 when no start). Frontend Playwright: catalog side pills correct (Ventoux 3, Alpe d'Huez none, Stelvio 3, Tourmalet 2), AddSummitDialog side-select vs input-side-name branching works, side-switch updates distance/gradient, Mark-as-Conquered Ventoux → POST → profile fetched (~10s) → My Summits shows orange BÉDOIN side badge and Recharts elevation-profile chart, Map popup for Ventoux shows 'VIA BÉDOIN' label + elevation-profile inside popup, dialog z-index=9999 renders correctly over Leaflet map, Edit shows 'Update Summit' CTA.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer triggers benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning that surfaces as a webpack-dev-server error overlay in the browser. This does NOT affect production builds and does not indicate a real bug, but it can intercept pointer events during e2e tests. Consider disabling the webpack-dev-server overlay for warnings (devServer.client.overlay.warnings=false) or suppressing the ResizeObserver warning in index.js.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py: _apply_profile is called synchronously inside POST/PUT — Open-Elevation can take up to 25s (timeout), which blocks the API response. Consider making profile fetching optional/async (return 202 + background task) if latency becomes a concern in production.

Frontend: Editing an existing summit whose famous_col_id is set repopulates form via {...emptyForm, ...editSummit}, which correctly keeps side_name; however editing a summit and changing famous_col_id via preset select will overwrite user-entered side_name — acceptable but worth noting.
Minor: webpack-dev-server overlay noise from Recharts ResizeObserver — pin overlay.warnings=false in craco/webpack devServer config.
seed_data_creation: Test-created Ventoux summit was deleted at end (DELETE /api/summits/{id} -> ok).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_climb_side_profile.py covers famous-cols sides + full profile lifecycle. Open-Elevation is flaky; tests skip gracefully on 'failed'. During this run Bédoin fetch returned profile_status='ok' and profile chart rendered. Note: dev-server overlay from Recharts' benign ResizeObserver warning can intercept Playwright clicks — kill overlay via JS eval (document.querySelectorAll('#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay').forEach(e=>e.remove())) if needed.
